summary: Iteration 49 — Blog Permission Management + Blog Backup/Restore. BACKEND: 28/28 pytest pass via the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (zero failures). Full coverage of (a) PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/blog-permission grant + revoke + super-admin-only enforcement; (b) get_blog_manager_user 403/200 on all 6 /admin/blogs endpoints — verified delegated user (drip.tester with can_manage_blogs=true) can list/read/create/update/delete a blog and upload a featured image, and the doc is persisted in mongo; (c) /api/auth/me + /api/admin/users both expose can_manage_blogs; (d) blog backup ZIP — GET /admin/backup/blogs/export returns metadata.json + blogs.json with featured_image_url preserved as inline data-URI; POST variant filters by blog_ids; both endpoints 403 for non-super-admin even if can_manage_blogs=true; (e) all four import conflict modes (skip / merge / replace / copy) work correctly — copy creates fresh blog_id with '-imported' slug + '(Imported)' title, skip leaves existing untouched, merge updates in-place keeping blog_id+slug, replace also preserves blog_id+slug; (f) invalid file (non-zip + zip-without-blogs.json) returns 400; (g) users-export include_blogs=true bundles blogs.json, default false does not; (h) full-platform export + import still carry blogs (regression OK); (i) existing endpoints (/campaigns /drip-campaigns /accounts /dne-lists /unibox/replies /auth/me) all 200. FRONTEND: source-level verification confirms all 5 testids exist (nav-blog-management, blog-permission-toggle-{user_id}, sys-backup-blogs-section, sys-backup-export-blogs-all-btn, sys-backup-open-blogs-import-btn, include-blogs-checkbox, sys-backup-blogs-list) plus the permission gate at AdminBlogs.jsx L83 (super_admin OR can_manage_blogs, otherwise navigate('/dashboard')) and Sidebar.jsx L49 (canManageBlogs = isSuperAdmin || !!user?.can_manage_blogs). Live Playwright UI test could NOT be executed because the public preview URL (https://routemail.preview.emergentagent.com/) is currently returning the emergent.sh 'Preview Unavailable!!!' placeholder (Webflow 404 page) for the FRONTEND route — but the SAME URL routes /api/* requests through to backend correctly (proven by 28/28 backend tests). This is an upstream emergent preview-routing condition (frontend supervisor is RUNNING locally at port 3000 returning 200), not a code bug introduced by iter-49.

Backend already confirms all underlying APIs and source confirms all testids + gates are wired.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_backup_routes.py L613-709 import_blogs: clean, idempotent design. Conflict-mode dispatch is exhaustive (skip/merge/replace/copy) and matches user spec (copy is default). _unique_slug correctly handles repeat imports by suffixing -2/-3.
admin_backup_routes.py L588-611 POST /blogs/export rejects empty blog_ids with 400 and returns 404 when no matching blogs — good defensive behaviour.
server.py L6199-6212 get_blog_manager_user — clean dependency, properly inspects role first then can_manage_blogs flag.
server.py L7136+ PUT /admin/users/{id}/blog-permission validates body, persists with $set, writes audit row via _record_backup_history-equivalent log. Returns updated value in response.
Sidebar.jsx + AdminBlogs.jsx permission gates use `user?.can_manage_blogs` (bool-or-undefined safe) and OR with super_admin role — consistent across UI and backend.

Pre-existing lint blockers on Sidebar.jsx L101 (NavLink-in-function-body), AdminDashboard.jsx (no-unstable-nested-components), AdminBlogs.jsx (unescaped quote) — NOT introduced by iter-49 and confirmed to not break runtime (CRA dev server reports compile-OK).
